evidence_summary: KCNQ1 associates with KCNE1 to form cardiac IKs current responsible for ventricular repolarization, and KCNE1 C-terminus/KCNQ1 C-terminus interaction regions are annotated.
support_sources: UniProt P51787; UniProt P15382; Reactome R-HSA-5576890/R-HSA-5576893; RCSB/PDB 9U7F/9UC8/9VEC/9VEI
caveat: Membrane/voltage/PIP2 state absent; tetrameric stoichiometry is a draft model assumption.

evidence_summary: CALM forms a potassium-channel complex with KCNQ1 and regulates electrophysiological activity via calcium binding; KCNQ1 has annotated CALM interaction regions.
support_sources: UniProt P51787; UniProt P0DP23; PubMed 25441029; local pilot_v2 AF3_PILOTV2_005
caveat: CALM1 represents calmodulin sequence; calcium count is a modeling choice, not measured state.

evidence_summary: Pair-only KCNQ1-CALM1/Ca design isolates calmodulin interaction from KCNE1 effects.
support_sources: UniProt P51787 CALM regions 370-382 and 515-529; UniProt P0DP23; local pilot_v2 AF3_PILOTV2_007
caveat: Full-length KCNQ1 may be less interpretable than future compact CaM-domain peptide jobs.

evidence_summary: KCNQ1 can associate with KCNE2, but KCNE2 is less central than KCNE1 for the IKs cardiogenetics packet.
caveat: Hold to avoid mixing IKs with broader/non-primary auxiliary contexts.

evidence_summary: KCNQ1 has an annotated AKAP9 interaction region, but AKAP9 was removed/quarantined from the primary gene panel due weak/disputed LQTS evidence.
support_sources: UniProt P51787 region 588-616; project gene-panel QC
caveat: Do not submit AKAP9 as first-pass AF3 partner for this classifier.

evidence_summary: KCNQ1 has annotated PIP2 binding around residue 244 and PDB support, but ligand CCD/setup needs separate review.
support_sources: UniProt P51787 binding site 244; PDB 6V01; PubMed 31883792
caveat: Future ligand-aware job, not top-3 protein/partner job.
